text: ® SQL includes a string-matching operator for comparisons on character strings. The operator “like” uses patterns that are described using two special characters: » percent (%). The % character matches any substring. » underscore (_). The _ character matches any character. ® Find the names of all instructors whose name includes the substring “dar". select name 9 S“LJ(MJ from instructor where name like 'ar m Match the string “100 %” like “100\%' escape '\' ® SQL supports a variety of string operations such as » concatenation (using “||”) « converting from upper to lower case (and vice versa) « finding string length, extracting substrings, etc.
